name: pandadesk-lite
description: AI support chat for one website, on your own Cloudflare account with your own keys.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password for your admin page at `/admin`. Pick a long one, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 24`. Your AI key, email and everything else are set on the admin page after deploying.

DB.description: Stores your knowledge, chats and settings.

VECTORS.description: Search by meaning. Optional: without it, search uses keywords.

AI.description: Cloudflare Workers AI: makes the search index, and answers questions until you add your own AI key.
